tex_content.html:
Remark
[Boundary oscillation from Sobolev trace data] 1. ch8:8.29\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $u-v\in W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )$ and $v\in C^0(\overline\Omega )$, then the boundary oscillation of $u$ tends to zero at every boundary point. If $v\in C^{\alpha _0}(\overline\Omega )$, it satisfies a uniform bound of order $R^{\alpha _0}$.
